professional_summary: Technical support and customer service professional with 10+ years of experience troubleshooting technology, supporting customers, installing and maintaining hardware, working with proprietary software systems, and resolving technical issues in both field and high-volume support environments. Experienced with residential networking, Wi-Fi, hardware installation, connected devices, audio/video systems, Salesforce, mobile applications, and specialized technology platforms. Hands-on independent software development experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Tailwind CSS. Known for learning unfamiliar technology quickly, communicating clearly with customers, troubleshooting problems systematically, and working independently with minimal supervision.

experience.title: Field Representative

highlights: Installed, configured, maintained, and troubleshot proprietary hardware and software integrated with televisions, home theater systems, audio equipment, and residential technology.
Completed extensive hands-on technical training to independently install, maintain, and troubleshoot specialized Nielsen systems.
Transitioned to a new Nielsen measurement platform, learning new hardware, software, installation procedures, troubleshooting processes, and maintenance requirements.
Used Salesforce to manage participant information, appointments, schedules, work assignments, and field-service activities.
Used mobile applications to troubleshoot issues, manage equipment, document service activity, and maintain or update installed systems.
Independently managed an assigned geographic territory, including scheduling, travel, equipment, service calls, and daily workload.
Responded directly to participant calls, providing technical assistance, troubleshooting, answering questions, and resolving concerns.
Used customer-service and de-escalation techniques when handling frustrated participants or difficult technical situations.
Maintained company-issued vehicle, equipment, supplies, and resources required to operate the assigned territory.
Adapted quickly to proprietary technology, unfamiliar systems, and major platform changes while working independently with minimal supervision.

experience.title: Double Agent

highlights: Installed, configured, and troubleshot home theater systems, televisions, surround sound, audio/video equipment, and connected devices.
Designed, installed, configured, and troubleshot residential networking environments, including routers, Wi-Fi, mesh networks, and connected devices.
Diagnosed connectivity, configuration, and hardware problems and explained technical solutions to customers with varying levels of technical knowledge.
